Comprehensive Skill Gap Analysis and PRD Frameworks for transitioning from Product Operations and Psychology to AI Product Manager (AI PM).

Research Requirements:
1. Conduct a detailed skill mapping between Product Operations / Advertising / New Media / Psychology competencies (user research, operational data analytics, content strategy, user psychology, A/B testing, growth loops) and entry-to-mid-level AI Product Manager requirements.
2. Technical Concepts & Fundamentals needed:
   - LLM fundamentals: tokens, context windows, prompt engineering, temperature, top_p, halluncination mitigation.
   - Model Evaluation: Quantitative metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, Perplexity, accuracy, latency, cost per 1k tokens) vs qualitative evaluation (LLM-as-a-judge, human-in-the-loop evaluation, benchmark suites like MMLU, C-Eval, AlignBench).
   - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) vs. Fine-tuning vs. System Prompting: architecture trade-offs, vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone, Qdrant), embedding models, chunking strategies.
   - Data Pipelines & Data Operations: synthetic data generation, data cleaning, labeling workflows, feedback loops (RLHF / DPO / user implicit feedback).
   - AI UX/UI Design Patterns: streaming responses (SSE), fallback/graceful error handling, prompt suggestions, confidence scores, human override/editing mechanisms, multimodal interaction.
3. Provide a structured template and guidelines for writing an AI Feature PRD (Product Requirements Document), highlighting how it differs from traditional software PRDs (e.g., probabilistic vs deterministic behavior, edge cases, fallback logic, evaluation criteria, model latency SLA).
